title: Lost in translation: code for the CpG-level evaluation of the clinical value of cancer DNA methylation markers (NDRG4, GREM1, LY75)
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript Lost in translation: How CpG site selection and assay design determine the clinical value of cancer DNA methylation markers (Lommen, Coussement et al.).

The repository contains the processing pipeline for targeted (amplicon) bisulfite sequencing, including the amplicon-aware assignment of read pairs to overlapping amplicons, and the R analysis that evaluates the diagnostic (NDRG4, colorectal cancer) and prognostic (GREM1, clear-cell renal cell carcinoma; LY75, melanoma) value of individual CpGs, amplicons, read-based measures and MSP assays using the Akaike Information Criterion, together with the intra-amplicon comparisons of CpGs. A conda environment file lists the tools and versions used.

Patient data are not included.
